ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.70 to the rider.

What the evidence shows. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02828) is complete — 114 fixes at 10-second intervals across the whole trip, 100% coverage, no gaps — and measures the trip at 14.4 km against the platform's optimal route of 9.0 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02828). The excess is 5.4 km, or 60% of optimal. Both tests in POL-RD-01 pass (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), so the deviation is established, and at 60% it is additionally a MATERIAL deviation. The governing distance figure is the trace, not the rounded copy carried on the trip record. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: max_gap_sec is 0.0, there is no jump over 500 m and no sampling interval over 30 seconds, so the deviation can be found on the trace alone.

The driver's explanation. The driver's statement that there were 'road works' is not supported by anything. The only traffic advisory for this trip, EV-ADVIS-02828-01, is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) with no payload at all. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the advisory for this trip and nothing else; with no advisory on file, POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because no evidence ID for an advisory was cited, POL-RD-13(1) applies and POL-RD-10(5) does not fire, so the case does not escalate. The excess therefore stands at the measured 5.4 km against the booked 9.0 km optimal, and no closure-adjusted optimal exists.

No other driver-side clause applies. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02828) holds 0 messages, so there is no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04; the trip record carries null pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km, so the POL-RD-05 relocation re-quote is absent and the booked optimal stands; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply.

The driver-profile check. Because the deviation is MATERIAL, POL-RD-06 requires the check and it is run. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 2, below the threshold of 3, and 2 over 180 completed trips in 90 days is 0.011, below 0.05. No repeat pattern is established, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (4) is a different, context-only field under POL-GEN-01 and was not used.

The refund. The fare (EV-FARE-02828) is METERED. Under POL-RD-02: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 9.0 km + 0.28 x 13.0 min) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02828, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, toll, surcharge, waiting fee or promo = SGD 14.99. Refund = charged_total 20.66 less 14.99 = 5.67, rounded up to SGD 5.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and 27.4% of the charge, well below the 90% that would make it a full refund, so the outcome is a partial refund. The fare carries zero ERP gantry lines and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top. On the driver's separate compensation limb, the distance billed (14.4 km) equals the distance traced, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall and no compensation is due.

The driver argued the refund should be capped at the SGD 4.00 shown in the dispute record. I do not accept that. No clause caps a refund at the contested figure: POL-RD-02 keys the refund to charged_total and the recomputed fare, and states its full-refund test as a share of charged_total. The SGD 4.00 is not an operative ceiling.

Confidence is 0.90; every artifact carrying the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02828, EV-TRIP-02828, EV-FARE-02828) is at weight 1.0, and the missing advisory carries nothing. The monetary effect, SGD 5.70, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically. Neither a safety nor a complaint flag is present, so this provisional ruling issues without human review and carries the usual appeal route.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
